p: dreamed: This dream was not so much for Pharaoh, as is was a means to deliver Joseph and to provide for God's Church.
second time: All these means God used to deliver his servant, and to bring him into favour and authority.
troubled: This fear was enough to teach him that this vision was sent by God.
do remember my faults this day: He confesses his fault against the king before he speaks of Joseph.
Joseph: The wicked seek the prophets of God in their time of need, while in their prosperity they abhor them.
It is not in me: As though he would say if I interpret your dream it comes from God, and not from me.
The dream of Pharaoh is one: Both his dreams have the same message.
look out a man discreet and: The office of a true prophet is not only to show the evils to come, but also the remedies for the same.
Spirit of God is: No one should be honoured who does not have gifts from God fitting for the same.
word shall all my people be: Some read, "the people will kill your mouth", that is obey you in all things.
Or "Abrech": a sign of honour; a word some translate, tender father or father of the king, or kneel down.
thirty years old when he stood: His age is mentioned both to show that his authority came from God, and also that he endured imprisonment and exile for twelve years or more.
father's house: Nonetheless, his father's house was the true Church of God: yet the company of the wicked and prosperity caused him to forget it.
